newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Christopher meets Netanyahu on Mideast mission.
newsitem.headline: Christopher meets Netanyahu on Mideast mission.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem on Sunday to urge him to make swift progress on peace moves with Palestinians after an eruption of violence.
Christopher was also due to meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in the Gaza Strip ahead of resumed Israeli-PLO talks later on Sunday. Fifty-eight Arabs and 15 Israelis have died in the violence.
